cdt:Metadata.cdt:Title: Rename OM modeling language to Class/Object/Field/Operation
cdt:Metadata.cdt:Summary: Plan a breaking, no-compatibility vocabulary and storage/API redesign for the ontology object model, and coordinate the dependent knowledge-base project to follow the same naming system.

cdt:ProjectRef.cdt:Role: Primary project that owns the OM schema, API, contracts, tests, and Codument records.
Dependent project that must migrate ontology API usage, direct OM table usage, and project skill assets after the host redesign.

cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Planner: Maintain the target naming design, task DAG, acceptance criteria, and replanning boundary for the ontology core.
cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Observer: Read implementation, tests, Codument records, and build output to compare actual state with the mission target.
cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Reconciler: Decide whether observed drift requires a new track, a revised track scope, or mission blocking.
cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Applier: Execute approved tracks and local code/document changes inside the ontology core project.

cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Planner: Plan dependent knowledge-base updates against the new ontology contract.
cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Observer: Inspect knowledge-base source, tests, and direct Cozo queries for legacy OM vocabulary.
cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Reconciler: Separate required follow-up work from unrelated knowledge-base concerns.
cdt:ActorSet.cdt:Applier: Execute approved dependent-project migration tracks once the ontology core contract is available.

cdt:Port.cdt:Description: Mission-local analysis, decision tree notes, and temporary investigation output.
Mission execution reports, verification notes, and replan summaries.
Future implementation tracks created and executed by this mission.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Inventory and freeze the target language
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Establish a complete current-state inventory and freeze the agreed breaking rename matrix before implementation tracks.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Inventory legacy OM vocabulary in ontology core
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Find Type, Entity, Attribute, Property, Edge, Action, and related storage/API/model/test/doc usages.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Inventory dependent knowledge-base usage
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Find ontology API calls, direct Cozo table/query references, and generated/handwritten skill assets that must follow the host rename.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Inventory knowledge-base skills vocabulary
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Scan root business skills, skill references, skill scripts, skill tests, and any versioned agent-skill copies for legacy Type/Entity/Attribute/Property/Edge/Action OM wording.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Freeze glossary, table rename matrix, and API rename matrix
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Confirm the mission design remains aligned with the user-approved Class/Object/Field/ComputedProp/Relation/Operation vocabulary.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Breakingly redesign ontology core contracts and storage
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Create and execute implementation tracks that rename public API, models, schema tables, Cozo queries, tests, and docs without legacy compatibility.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Create and execute ontology class/object/field storage-contract track
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Rename Type to Class, Entity to Object, Attribute to Field, Property to FieldValue, and related aliases/hierarchy/query contracts.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Create and execute ontology relation/computed/operation behavior track
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Rename Edge to RelationLink, action concepts to Operation, computed definitions to ComputedProp, and update behavior/interceptor/permission surfaces.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Verify ontology core has no legacy public or storage OM vocabulary
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Build, test, and scan for accidental legacy aliases or old table names outside explicitly documented historical notes.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Migrate dependent knowledge-base project
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: After ontology core exposes the new breaking contract, update knowledge-base code, direct Cozo queries, tests, and documentation to the same language.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Create and execute knowledge-base follow-up migration track
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Replace legacy ontology API/table/skill vocabulary in the dependent project with the new Class/Object/Field/ComputedProp/Relation/Operation contract.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Update knowledge-base skill contracts and examples
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Ensure project skills, reference docs, validator/audit scripts, tests, examples, and prompts stop teaching old OM vocabulary and express the new modeling API consistently.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Verify knowledge-base against the renamed ontology contract
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Run relevant builds/tests and scan code, docs, and skills for old OM table/API/terminology usage that would break or mislead after the host rename.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Cross-project verification and mission close
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Confirm the redesigned vocabulary is coherent across both projects, then archive durable decisions and modeling memory.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Run cross-project final verification
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Confirm ontology core and knowledge-base pass agreed checks and no required migration work remains.

cdt:Task.cdt:Title: Close and archive mission
cdt:Task.cdt:Description: Promote durable naming decisions and archive the mission after successful verification.
